critical.title: Exposed API Keys in Source Code
critical.description: OpenRouter API key found in openclaw.json (sk-or-v1-...)
critical.impact: Attacker can abuse API quota, cause billing damage
critical.recommendation: Rotate immediately. Use environment variables or secure vault.

critical.title: Supabase Key in Plain Text Script
critical.description: Supabase API key exposed in supabase_read.py file
critical.recommendation: Rotate key. Use .env files or OpenClaw credential store.

critical.title: Telegram Bot Tokens in Config
critical.description: Two Telegram bot tokens exposed in openclaw.json
critical.impact: Account takeover, bot spam, message interception
critical.recommendation: Rotate both bot tokens. Move to environment variables.

critical.title: No Firewall Protection
critical.evidence: SSH open on port 22 with no rate limiting
critical.recommendation: Enable UFW and configure fail2ban for SSH protection

critical.title: OpenClaw Gateway on Loopback Only
critical.description: Gateway bound to 127.0.0.1 - good isolation, but verify intentional
critical.impact: No remote access to gateway (likely intentional)
critical.recommendation: Document as intentional. Verify no unintended exposure.

high.title: No Backup Strategy Documented
high.description: No cron jobs or backup services visible
high.evidence: unattended-upgrades service running but no backup daemon
high.recommendation: Implement daily automated backups to S3 or remote store

high.title: Minimal SSH Hardening
high.description: SSH on standard port 22, no evidence of key-only auth documented
high.evidence: Failed sudo auth attempts in journals indicate password auth attempts
high.recommendation: Consider port 2222, disable password auth, require SSH keys

medium.title: Single-Core Task Bottleneck
medium.description: Only 2 CPU cores; multiple agents could contend for resources
medium.evidence: Current load 0.1 is minimal, but growth will saturate quickly
medium.impact: Agent response latency, timeouts during peak usage
medium.recommendation: Monitor CPU load. Plan upgrade to 4-core if >50% sustained load

medium.title: No Swap Space
medium.description: Swap is 0GB; OOM kills instead of graceful degradation
medium.impact: Agent process crashes if memory exhausted
medium.recommendation: Add 2-4GB swap or upgrade to larger instance

high.title: No Load Balancing or Redundancy
high.description: Single-node deployment; no failover or HA setup
high.evidence: One srv1476702 instance running all agents
high.recommendation: Plan multi-node deployment or standby replica in future

high.title: API Cost Scaling
high.description: 5 agents on OpenRouter pay-per-use could cause runaway costs
high.evidence: Multiple LLM models with no usage limits documented
high.recommendation: Set OpenRouter usage caps, monitor daily spend, implement rate limits

high.title: Supabase Free Tier Limits
high.description: Unknown if on free or paid Supabase tier
high.evidence: linus_infra table write required but no tier documented
high.recommendation: Verify Supabase tier, plan upgrade path

high.title: No Monitoring or Alerting
high.description: No evidence of Prometheus, DataDog, or other monitoring
high.evidence: Manual inspection required to assess health
high.recommendation: Deploy Grafana + Prometheus or use cloud monitoring (DataDog, New Relic)

high.title: No Log Aggregation
high.description: Logs only on local rsyslog, no centralized store
high.impact: Log loss if disk fails, hard to debug distributed issues
high.recommendation: Send logs to ELK, Loki, or cloud logging (CloudWatch, Stackdriver)

high.title: No Disaster Recovery Plan
high.description: No documented RTO/RPO or recovery procedures
high.impact: Extended recovery time if data loss occurs
high.recommendation: Document RTO/RPO targets, implement backup+restore testing

concerns.title: Uncontrolled OpenRouter API Spend
concerns.example: 5 agents × 10 calls/hour × 24 hours = 1,200 calls/day = ~36,000 calls/month. At $0.01-0.05 per call = $360-1800/month
concerns.recommendation: Implement per-agent quotas, daily spend alerts, and hard caps

concerns.title: Supabase Cost Growth
concerns.recommendation: Review Supabase billing, set alerts, plan tier upgrade

concerns.title: VPS Cost Inflation
concerns.recommendation: Monitor bandwidth, plan for auto-scaling if needed

HIGH: Set OpenRouter API spending caps and daily alerts
